channel.title: Stanley Ngugi
channel.description: Technical writing by Stanley Ngugi on AI for formal methods — LLM theorem proving, grammar-constrained decoding, RL environments — and machine learning research.

item.title: Lean Tactics Under Constraint
item.description: How grammar masking changes Lean tactic outputs: a reproducible Qwen comparison, token-level mechanics, exact denominators, latency, and exploratory Goedel runs.

item.title: The Shape of a Lean Tactic
item.description: A worked study of Lean tactic grammars: explicit syntax, permissive fallbacks, corpus extraction, mutation tests, and a reduced-grammar ablation.

item.title: Taming Incidental Polysemanticity in Toy Models: How Network Training Choices Affect Feature Entanglement
item.description: An exploratory study using sparse autoencoders to measure how L1 vs L2 regularization, initialization, and activation choices shape polysemanticity in overcomplete networks.
